pass_a_gloss: No wife in the hundredfold: resurrection as angels.
pass_b_english: Together, keep the holy multiplication Scripture promises — of brothers and children and parents and fields and houses. But wife is not counted with these. For it is not said, 'Everyone who left brothers or sisters or parents or children or fields or houses or wife for my name's sake shall receive manifold.' 'For in the resurrection of the dead they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels in the heavens.' (Matthew 19:29) (Matthew 22:30)
